verdict.rationale: Parsec's own docs show the host can scope guests: a guest can 'observe or even take control' (view-only versus control), and the host decides which apps guests may see and interact with. Nothing in the evidence covers clipboard or file-access permissions, so only half the story is shown. Missing for 10: per-connection clipboard permission controls, file-transfer/file-access permission controls, detailed permission documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.
